capabilities: Render chart panels inside weekly, monthly and yearly notes via a code block
Derive project, session and task statistics from existing daily and session notes
Break down project donut overflow into ranked bar rows
Show optional goal progress from a dedicated notes section
Fold project name spelling variants into one project via settings
extras: The interface, panel titles, and default frontmatter keys and folder names are Polish; only folder names and the goals heading are configurable. Needs Obsidian 1.12.7 or newer. The README also mentions installing pre-release builds manually, which do not auto-update.
problem: Obsidian periodic notes hold the raw data but offer no way to visualize how a period was spent without filling in extra tracking.
summary: Chart dashboard for periodic notes: renders project, activity, task and goal charts inside weekly, monthly and yearly notes.
